title: Magnet Explorer
shareTitle: Magnet Explorer — A Hands-On Magnetic Science Game
description: Drag a friendly magnet, test real materials, sweep up steel treasures, and guide a shiny ball through a wooden maze.
learningGoals: Observe magnetic and non-magnetic behavior through direct testing
Recognize several familiar steel objects without claiming every metal is magnetic
Explore how magnetic attraction changes with distance
interactionModel: Direct magnet interaction: bring a magnet near objects, sweep for magnetic treasures, and guide a steel ball through a maze.
feedbackModel: Near-field steel objects snap to the magnet with a clink, glow, and haptic pulse; other materials bounce gently with supportive recorded narration.
credits: Kaigani; GPT Image 2 object system; local Krea 2 environments; Qwen voice-clone narration. Full provenance in ASSETS.md. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
